_placeholder: Template for data/scenarios/demos.json (JSON has no comments; remove the _-prefixed keys (_placeholder, _recordings_note) before use — demosrv rejects unknown fields). scenarioDir and store are REPO-ROOT-relative (run demosrv from the repo root). run is a single NATS token matching [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ (it also rides the app URL raw) and must NOT end in "-replay" (ADR-0006 reserves that suffix for replay-plane ids). seed/ticks are OPTIONAL: they override the scenario manifest for this demo (serve's -seed/-ticks); omit them to run the manifest as authored. capacity is OPTIONAL: driver claim capacity (serve's -capacity, default 1000) — raise it for dense/overload demos, since ADR-0008's pause gate pauses the run when live unclaimed vehicles exceed spare capacity. recordings is OPTIONAL: VCR entries replayed by engine/cmd/replay — store is the durable JetStream store dir written by serve -store (the recording serve must have EXITED; demosrv's kill-before-spawn enforces store exclusivity), run is the recorded run id (the live plane is {run}-replay), scenarioDir is the scenario the recording was made from (network GeoJSON + dt hint). ids are unique ACROSS demos and recordings (they share /net/{id}); demo run ids must ALSO be unique (they share one NATS-subject namespace) — recording run ids need NOT be (recording a demo's run is the normal case; the planes are disjoint). At least one demo is required (recordings-only registries are not supported).

_recordings_note: A recording's scenarioDir supplies the display network + dt at start time; do not edit the scenario after recording (the recorded run meta is authoritative for execution, the scenario for display).

recordings.title: My scenario — recorded run (VCR replay)
recordings.blurb: Replays a run recorded earlier with serve -store. Pause/resume/speed/seek from the replay panel.
